identity_A: CORRECT. Derivation: under the hard-core measure at lam, condition on J = I cap R. Every subset of R is independent, and I cap L can be any subset of A_J = {v in L : N(v) cap J empty}, with weight lam^{|I cap L|}; so I cap L is product Bernoulli(p), p = lam/(1+lam), on A_J, |I cap L| ~ Bin(B_J, p), and J has marginal weight lam^{|J|}(1+lam)^{B_J}/Z. Lambda-free form: I_T(x) = sum_{J subset R} x^{|J|}(1+x)^{B_J}, i.e. i_j = sum_J C(B_J, j-|J|). The second difference is linear in the pmf, so 2p_k - p_{k-1} - p_{k+1} = E_J[h_{B_J}(k-|J|)]. Fixed kernel: on E0 = {B_J >= B0}, Bin(B_J,p) = Bin(B_J-B0,p) + Bin(B0,p) independently, so P(X=j,E0) = sum_m P(M'=m,E0) b_{B0}(j-m). This conditioning is Fang's own (Lemma 6.1 and (7.3), fang.txt l.761); the new content is using it for the second difference.
